name: Squeeze the Beam
description: Focus the beams for more collisions: all data is doubled for 30 seconds.

name: Particle ID
description: Name the particles in five detector slices. Every right answer makes a one-minute data boost bigger, up to three times as much data.

name: Trigger Frenzy
description: For 15 seconds, every click on the detector gives 10 times as much data. Click fast!

name: Press Conference
description: Announce your latest results and get a minute of funding right away.

name: Calibration Run
description: Recalibrate the detector and recover a minute of data right away.

name: Anomaly Hunt
description: Comb through the data: an anomaly appears on the detector right away.

name: Night Shift
description: Everyone stays late: all data is tripled for 45 seconds.

name: Lucky Break
description: All your other lab actions are ready to use again.
